placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Salthouse Fields is a handy starting point for a Clevedon day out. The play areas and open grass give children room to move, with the seafront close by for a change of scenery.

Our family idea: bring a picnic and choose between another turn on the playground or a short stroll by Marine Lake. Look for the model railway when it is operating; rides are a separate paid activity.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Younger children, relaxed picnics and short seaside outings.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Play areas, skate park, tennis courts and a seasonal model railway.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use signed seafront parking and check the current tariff and time limits.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Entry to the fields is free; rides and other activities may cost extra. Supervise children beside the lake and seafront.
